D.fee_policy: conservative sidecar schedule, docs table fallback, unknown 0.07
D.member_count_rule: Event member count per D event-capture: the count of the latest event_members row fetched at or before the capture time (member_count_source='asof') where one exists; otherwise the first-fetched count for that neg_risk_market_id (member_count_source='first_fetch'), with member_count_lag_h = fetch time minus capture time recorded per event-capture. No count at all => ineligible (no_member_count). Justification: eligible events are non-augmented neg-risk events, which have fixed member sets (augmented and neg_risk_other events are excluded by the eligibility rules), so a count fetched shortly after a capture describes the same member set; the lag is disclosed, never hidden. The primary analysis uses both sources. A declared sensitivity re-runs D1/D2 restricted to as-of counts only (results key sensitivity_asof_only). The census and results report the number of event-captures by source (asof, first_fetch, none).

tests.D2: mean net=1-C_exec per trigger at next capture, >0

declaration.batch_holm_family: The batch Holm family is every test that advanced at Stage 1 in any CB1 module (history A/C/E Stage-1 screens, D dev) plus B1 and B2, which have no Stage 1 and are always in the family. A Stage-2 test that is missing from the supplied Stage-2 files counts as p = 1 and is listed. The batch-holm command takes the Stage-1 (dev) results files and the Stage-2 files, derives the expected test list from the dev files plus the always-included tests, and refuses if any Stage-2 file contains a test outside that expected list.
